name: Lax979537Proofs.PersistentStack.Chain.nil_iff
statement: theorem Chain.nil_iff {H : Heap Node Symbol} {p : Option Node} : Chain H p [] ↔ p = none

name: Lax979537Proofs.PersistentStack.Chain.none_iff
statement: theorem Chain.none_iff {H : Heap Node Symbol} {xs : List Symbol} : Chain H none xs ↔ xs = []

name: Lax979537Proofs.PersistentStack.Chain.read_exists
statement:
theorem Chain.read_exists {H : Heap Node Symbol} {head : Option Node} {xs : List Symbol}

name: Lax979537Proofs.PersistentStack.Chain.some_iff
statement:
theorem Chain.some_iff {H : Heap Node Symbol} {n : Node} {xs : List Symbol} :
    Chain H (some n) xs ↔ ∃ a p ys, (n, a, p) ∈ H ∧ Chain H p ys ∧ xs = a :: ys

name: Lax979537Proofs.PersistentStack.Chain.unique
statement:
theorem Chain.unique {H : Heap Node Symbol} (hH : Functional H) {p : Option Node} {xs ys : List Symbol}
    (hx : Chain H p xs) (hy : Chain H p ys) : xs = ys

name: Lax979537Proofs.PersistentStack.insert_functional

theorem insert_functional {H : Heap Node Symbol} (hH : Functional H) {n : Node}

name: Lax979537Proofs.PersistentStack.push_chain
statement:
theorem push_chain {H : Heap Node Symbol} {p : Option Node} {xs : List Symbol}
    (h : Chain H p xs) (n : Node) (a : Symbol) : Chain (insert (n, a, p) H) (some n) (a :: xs)

name: Lax979537Proofs.PersistentStack.read_correct
statement:
theorem read_correct {H : Heap Node Symbol} (hH : Functional H)
    {head parent : Option Node} {xs : List Symbol} {value : Option Symbol}
    (h : Chain H head xs) (hr : Read H head value parent) :
    value = xs.head? ∧ Chain H parent xs.tail

name: Lax979537Proofs.PersistentStack.read_map_correct
statement:
theorem read_map_correct {A : Type} (f : A → Symbol) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {H : Heap Node Symbol} (hH : Functional H) {head parent : Option Node}
    {xs : List A} {value : Option A} (h : Chain H head (xs.map f))
    (hr : Read H head (value.map f) parent) :
    value = xs.head? ∧ Chain H parent (xs.tail.map f)

name: Lax979537Proofs.PersistentStack.read_unique
statement:
theorem read_unique {H : Heap Node Symbol} (hH : Functional H) {head p q : Option Node}
    {a b : Option Symbol} (ha : Read H head a p) (hb : Read H head b q) : a = b ∧ p = q

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.halt_fixed

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.iterate_refines

    (hC : ∀ l, weight (M l) + 1 ≤ C) (n : Nat) (c : TM2.Cfg Γ Λ State) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ C * n ∧ (next M)^[t] (boundary c) = boundary ((macroNext M)^[n] c)

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.macro_matches

name: Lax979537Proofs.TM2Micro.statement_refines

name: Lax979537Proofs.PushEffects.target_added
statement:
theorem target_added (tm : FinTM2) {Node : Type} (fresh : Node)
    (heads : tm.K → Option Node)
    {c : TM2Micro.Cursor tm.Γ tm.Λ tm.σ} {v : tm.σ} {e : Effect tm}
    (ht : target tm c v = some e) :
    NodeMachine.added fresh ⟨c, v, heads⟩ = some (fresh, Sigma.mk e.key e.symbol, heads e.key)

name: Lax979537Proofs.PushEffects.target_step
statement:
theorem target_step (tm : FinTM2) {Node : Type} (fresh : Node)
    (H : NodeMachine.Records Node tm.Γ) (heads : tm.K → Option Node)
    {c : TM2Micro.Cursor tm.Γ tm.Λ tm.σ} {v : tm.σ} {e : Effect tm}
    (ht : target tm c v = some e) :
    NodeMachine.Step tm.m fresh H ⟨c, v, heads⟩
      (insert (fresh, Sigma.mk e.key e.symbol, heads e.key) H)
      ⟨e.next, v, Function.update heads e.key (some fresh)⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.ReadEffects.empty_step
statement:
theorem empty_step (tm : FinTM2) {Node : Type} (fresh : Node)
    (H : NodeMachine.Records Node tm.Γ) (heads : tm.K → Option Node)
    {c : TM2Micro.Cursor tm.Γ tm.Λ tm.σ} {v : tm.σ} {e : Effect tm}
    (ht : target tm c v = some e) (hempty : heads e.key = none) :
    NodeMachine.Step tm.m fresh H ⟨c, v, heads⟩ H ⟨e.next, e.state none, heads⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.ReadEffects.target_step
statement:
theorem target_step (tm : FinTM2) {Node : Type} (fresh : Node)
    (H : NodeMachine.Records Node tm.Γ) (heads : tm.K → Option Node)
    {c : TM2Micro.Cursor tm.Γ tm.Λ tm.σ} {v : tm.σ} {e : Effect tm}
    (ht : target tm c v = some e) (a : Option (tm.Γ e.key)) (parent : Option Node)
    (hr : PersistentStack.Read H (heads e.key) (a.map (Sigma.mk e.key)) parent) :
    NodeMachine.Step tm.m fresh H ⟨c, v, heads⟩ H ⟨e.next, e.state a, nextHeads e heads parent⟩

name: Lax979537Proofs.ReadSymbols.mem_values
statement:
theorem mem_values (tm : FinTM2) (k : tm.K) (a : tm.Γ k) :

name: Lax979537Proofs.RenameRecords.head_entries
statement:
theorem head_entries (e : α → β) (xs : List (α × Symbol)) :
    head (entries e xs) = (head xs).map e

name: Lax979537Proofs.RenameRecords.records_entries
statement:
theorem records_entries (e : α → β) (xs : List (α × Symbol))
    (n : β) (a : Symbol) (parent : Option β) :
    (n, a, parent) ∈ records (entries e xs) ↔
      ∃ p parent₀, e p = n ∧ parent₀.map e = parent ∧ (p, a, parent₀) ∈ records xs

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackProgram.Store.ext
statement:
theorem Store.ext {s t : Store Γ σ} (hs : s.state = t.state) (hk : s.stk = t.stk) :

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackProgram.runs_one
statement:
theorem runs_one [DecidableEq K] {Λ : Type} (code : Λ → TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ)
    (l : Λ) (s : Store Γ σ) (l' : Option Λ) (s' : Store Γ σ)
    (h : TM2.stepAux (code l) s.state s.stk = config l' s') :
    Runs code (some l) s l' s' 1

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackProgram.runs_trans
Lax979537Proofs.StackProgram.stepAux_jump
statement:
theorem stepAux_jump [DecidableEq K] {Λ : Type} (next : Option Λ)
    (s : Store Γ σ) : TM2.stepAux (jump next) s.state s.stk = config next s

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackProgram.stepAux_op
statement:
theorem stepAux_op [DecidableEq K] {Λ : Type} (o : Op Γ σ) (next : Option Λ)
    (s : Store Γ σ) :
    TM2.stepAux (o.compile next) s.state s.stk = config next (o.apply s)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTransfer.pop_working
statement:
theorem pop_working [DecidableEq K] (base : K → List Bool) (src dst : K)
    (hne : src ≠ dst) (xs ys : List Bool) (a : Aux) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    Op.apply (.pop src (fun s : Aux × Option Bool => fun b => (s.1, b)))
      (working base src dst xs ys a scratch) =
      working base src dst xs.tail ys a xs.head?

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTransfer.push_working
statement:
theorem push_working [DecidableEq K] (base : K → List Bool) (src dst : K)
    (xs ys : List Bool) (a : Aux) (b : Bool) :
    Op.apply (.push dst (fun s : Aux × Option Bool => s.2.getD false))
      (working base src dst xs ys a (some b)) =
      working base src dst xs (b :: ys) a (some b)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTransfer.working_input
statement:
theorem working_input (xs : List Bool) :
    working (fun _ : Bool => []) false true xs [] () none =
      ioStore false ((), none) xs

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTransfer.working_output
statement:
theorem working_output (xs : List Bool) :
    working (fun _ : Bool => []) false true [] xs () none =
      ioStore true ((), none) xs

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackBoolean.answer_returns
statement: theorem answer_returns (b : Bool) (s : EvalStore K Aux) : Returns (answer b) s b 1

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackBoolean.combine_saved
statement:
theorem combine_saved (port : K) (op : Bool → Bool → Bool) (b d : Bool) (s : EvalStore K Aux) :
    Op.apply (.pop port (fun s : ((Aux × Bool) × Bool) × Option Bool => fun a =>
      (((s.1.1.1, true), op (a.getD false) s.1.2), none))) (result d (saved port b s)) =
      result (op b d) s

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackBoolean.negate_returns
statement:
theorem negate_returns {p : EvalProgram K Aux} {s : EvalStore K Aux} {b : Bool} {cost : Nat}
    (h : Returns p s b cost) : Returns (.seq p negate) s (!b) (cost + 1)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackClear.pop_working
statement:
theorem pop_working (base : K → List Bool) (src : K) (xs : List Bool)
    (a : Aux) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    Op.apply (.pop src (fun s : Aux × Option Bool => fun b => (s.1, b)))
      (working base src xs a scratch) = working base src xs.tail a xs.head?

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackCompare.readPair_executes
statement:
theorem readPair_executes (base : K → List Bool) (left right : K) (hne : left ≠ right)
    (xs ys : List Bool) (a : Aux) (flag : Bool) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    Executes (readPair left right) (working base left right xs ys (a, flag) scratch)
      (working base left right xs.tail ys.tail (a, xs.head?.isSome) ys.head?) 2

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackCompare.residue_less
statement:
theorem residue_less (xs ys : List Bool) :
    (!(residue xs ys).leftPresent && (residue xs ys).rightHead.isSome) =
      decide (xs.length < ys.length)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackCompare.residue_size
statement:
theorem residue_size (xs ys : List Bool) :
    (residue xs ys).left.length + (residue xs ys).right.length ≤ xs.length + ys.length

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackCompare.scanLoop_executes
statement:
theorem scanLoop_executes (base : K → List Bool) (left right : K) (hne : left ≠ right)
    (xs ys : List Bool) (a : Aux) :
    ∃ c, c ≤ 3 * (xs.length + ys.length) + 1 ∧
      Executes (scanLoop left right)
        (working base left right xs.tail ys.tail (a, xs.head?.isSome) ys.head?)
        (working base left right (residue xs ys).left (residue xs ys).right
          (a, (residue xs ys).leftPresent) (residue xs ys).rightHead) c

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackCompare.scan_executes
statement:
theorem scan_executes (base : K → List Bool) (left right : K) (hne : left ≠ right)
    (xs ys : List Bool) (a : Aux) (flag : Bool) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    ∃ c, c ≤ 3 * (xs.length + ys.length) + 3 ∧
      Executes (scan left right) (working base left right xs ys (a, flag) scratch)
        (working base left right (residue xs ys).left (residue xs ys).right
          (a, (residue xs ys).leftPresent) (residue xs ys).rightHead) c

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackCopy.pop_working3
statement:
theorem pop_working3 (base : K → List Bool) (src left right : K)
    (hl : src ≠ left) (hr : src ≠ right) (xs ys zs : List Bool)
    (a : Aux) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    Op.apply (.pop src (fun s : Aux × Option Bool => fun b => (s.1, b)))
      (working3 base src left right xs ys zs a scratch) =
      working3 base src left right xs.tail ys zs a xs.head?

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackCopy.push_left
statement:
theorem push_left (base : K → List Bool) (src left right : K)
    (h : left ≠ right) (xs ys zs : List Bool) (a : Aux) (b : Bool) :
    Op.apply (.push left (fun s : Aux × Option Bool => s.2.getD false))
      (working3 base src left right xs ys zs a (some b)) =
      working3 base src left right xs (b :: ys) zs a (some b)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackCopy.push_right
statement:
theorem push_right (base : K → List Bool) (src left right : K)
    (xs ys zs : List Bool) (a : Aux) (b : Bool) :
    Op.apply (.push right (fun s : Aux × Option Bool => s.2.getD false))
      (working3 base src left right xs ys zs a (some b)) =
      working3 base src left right xs ys (b :: zs) a (some b)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackAtomic.not_less_both
statement: theorem not_less_both (a b : Nat) : (!(decide (a < b) || decide (b < a))) = decide (a = b)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackFor.foldRange_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem foldRange_eq_foldl (f : Nat → α → α) (start count : Nat) (a : α) :
    foldRange f start count a = (List.range' start count).foldl (fun a i => f i a) a

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackFor.foldRange_zero_eq
statement:
theorem foldRange_zero_eq (f : Nat → α → α) (n : Nat) (a : α) :
    foldRange f 0 n a = (List.range n).foldl (fun a i => f i a) a

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackFor.increment_pack
statement:
theorem increment_pack (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (counter coord : K)
    (a : α) (i remaining : Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    Op.apply (.push coord (fun _ : Aux × Option Bool => true))
      (pack base counter coord a i remaining scratch) =
      pack base counter coord a (i + 1) remaining scratch

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackFor.pop_pack
statement:
theorem pop_pack (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (counter coord : K) (hne : counter ≠ coord)
    (a : α) (i remaining : Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    Op.apply (.pop counter (fun s : Aux × Option Bool => fun b => (s.1, b)))
      (pack base counter coord a i remaining scratch) =
      pack base counter coord a i (remaining - 1) (if remaining = 0 then none else some true)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackExists.any_range_iff
statement:
theorem any_range_iff (b : Nat → Bool) (n : Nat) :
    (List.range n).any b = true ↔ ∃ i, i < n ∧ b i = true

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackExists.fold_or
statement:
theorem fold_or (b : Nat → Bool) (start count : Nat) (a : Bool) :
    foldRange (fun i a => a || b i) start count a =
      (a || (List.range' start count).any b)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackRepeat.readStore_counter
statement:
@[simp] theorem readStore_counter (counter : K) (s : BitStore K Aux) :
    (readStore counter s).stk counter = (s.stk counter).tail

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackRepeat.readStore_scratch
statement:
@[simp] theorem readStore_scratch (counter : K) (s : BitStore K Aux) :
    (readStore counter s).state.2 = (s.stk counter).head?

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackRepeat.repeatLoop_executes
statement:
theorem repeatLoop_executes (counter : K) (body : BitProgram K Aux)
    (f : BitStore K Aux → BitStore K Aux) (Valid : BitStore K Aux → Prop) (B : Nat)
    (hread : ∀ s, Valid s → Valid (readStore counter s))
    (hf : ∀ s, Valid s → Valid (f s))
    (hframe : ∀ s, Valid s → (f s).stk counter = s.stk counter)
    (hbody : ∀ s, Valid s → ∃ c, c ≤ B ∧ Executes body s (f s) c)
    (s : BitStore K Aux) (hs : Valid s) :
    ∃ c, c ≤ (B + 2) * (s.stk counter).length + 1 ∧
      Executes (repeatLoop counter body) (readStore counter s)
        (result counter f (s.stk counter).length s) c

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackRepeat.repeat_executes
statement:
theorem repeat_executes (counter : K) (body : BitProgram K Aux)
    (f : BitStore K Aux → BitStore K Aux) (Valid : BitStore K Aux → Prop) (B : Nat)
    (hread : ∀ s, Valid s → Valid (readStore counter s))
    (hf : ∀ s, Valid s → Valid (f s))
    (hframe : ∀ s, Valid s → (f s).stk counter = s.stk counter)
    (hbody : ∀ s, Valid s → ∃ c, c ≤ B ∧ Executes body s (f s) c)
    (s : BitStore K Aux) (hs : Valid s) :
    ∃ c, c ≤ (B + 2) * (s.stk counter).length + 2 ∧
      Executes (repeatCount counter body) s (result counter f (s.stk counter).length s) c

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackRepeat.result_spec
statement:
theorem result_spec (counter : K) (f : BitStore K Aux → BitStore K Aux)
    (Valid : BitStore K Aux → Prop)
    (hread : ∀ s, Valid s → Valid (readStore counter s))
    (hf : ∀ s, Valid s → Valid (f s))
    (hframe : ∀ s, Valid s → (f s).stk counter = s.stk counter)
    (s : BitStore K Aux) (hs : Valid s) :
    let t := result counter f (s.stk counter).length s
    Valid t ∧ t.stk counter = [] ∧ t.state.2 = none

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackPower.addTokens_working
statement:
theorem addTokens_working (base : K → List Bool) (counter out : K)
    (xs ys : List Bool) (a : Aux) (scratch : Option Bool) (m : Nat) :
    addTokens out m (working base counter out xs ys a scratch) =
      working base counter out xs (List.replicate m true ++ ys) a none

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackPower.eval_costPolynomial
statement: theorem eval_costPolynomial (k n : Nat) : (costPolynomial k).eval n = cost k n

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackIndex.eval_costPolynomial
statement: theorem eval_costPolynomial (n k : Nat) : (costPolynomial k).eval n = budget n k

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.eval_costPolynomial
statement:
theorem eval_costPolynomial (B : Polynomial Nat) (n k : Nat) :
    (costPolynomial B k).eval n = cost n (B.eval n) k

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.foldTuples_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem foldTuples_eq_foldl (n k : Nat) (f : List Nat → α → α) (a : α) :
    foldTuples n k f a = (tuples n k).foldl (fun a xs => f xs a) a

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.packTuple_const
statement:
theorem packTuple_const (s : BitStore K Aux) (slots : List (K × K))
    (a : α) (values remaining : List Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    packTuple (fun _ : α => s) slots a values remaining scratch =
      packTuple (fun _ : Unit => s) slots () values remaining scratch

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.packTuple_fresh
statement:
theorem packTuple_fresh (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (slots : List (K × K))
    (key : K) (hfresh : key ∉ ports slots) (a : α) (values remaining : List Nat)
    (scratch : Option Bool) :
    (packTuple base slots a values remaining scratch).stk key = (base a).stk key

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.packTuple_pack_scratch
statement:
theorem packTuple_pack_scratch (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (counter coord : K)
    (i remaining : Nat) (initial : Option Bool) (slots : List (K × K))
    (a : α) (values counters : List Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    packTuple (fun a => pack base counter coord a i remaining initial) slots a values counters scratch =
      packTuple (fun a => pack base counter coord a i remaining none) slots a values counters scratch

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.packTuple_setStack
statement:
theorem packTuple_setStack (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (slots : List (K × K))
    (key : K) (hfresh : key ∉ ports slots) (bits : α → List Bool)
    (a : α) (values remaining : List Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    packTuple (fun a => setStack (base a) key (bits a)) slots a values remaining scratch =
      setStack (packTuple base slots a values remaining scratch) key (bits a)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.packTuple_state
statement:
theorem packTuple_state (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (slots : List (K × K))
    (a : α) (values remaining : List Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    (packTuple base slots a values remaining scratch).state = ((base a).state.1, scratch)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.packTuple_stk_scratch
statement:
theorem packTuple_stk_scratch (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (slots : List (K × K))
    (a : α) (values remaining : List Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    (packTuple base slots a values remaining scratch).stk =
      (packTuple base slots a values remaining none).stk

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.pack_fresh
statement:
theorem pack_fresh (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (c x key : K)
    (hc : key ≠ c) (hx : key ≠ x) (a : α) (i remaining : Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    (pack base c x a i remaining scratch).stk key = (base a).stk key

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.pack_setStack
statement:
theorem pack_setStack (base : α → BitStore K Aux) (counter coord key : K)
    (hcounter : key ≠ counter) (hcoord : key ≠ coord) (bits : α → List Bool)
    (a : α) (i remaining : Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    pack (fun a => setStack (base a) key (bits a)) counter coord a i remaining scratch =
      setStack (pack base counter coord a i remaining scratch) key (bits a)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTuples.tupleValues_cons
statement:
theorem tupleValues_cons {n k : Nat} (i : Fin n) (v : Fin k → Fin n) :
    tupleValues (Fin.cons i v) = i.val :: tupleValues v

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackStages.foldRange_iterate
statement:
theorem foldRange_iterate (f : α → α) (start count : Nat) (a : α) :
    foldRange (fun _ => f) start count a = (f^[count]) a

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackLookup.discard_working
statement:
theorem discard_working (base : K → List Bool) (index table : K)
    (xs ys : List Bool) (a : Aux) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    discardStore table (working base index table xs ys a scratch) =
      working base index table xs ys.tail a scratch

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackOutput.length_executes
Lax979537Proofs.StackOutput.length_op
statement:
theorem length_op {Γ : K → Type} {State : Type} (o : Op Γ State) (s : Store Γ State) (key : K) :
    ((o.apply s).stk key).length ≤ (s.stk key).length + 1

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTake.body_executes
statement:
theorem body_executes (src dst : K) (s : BitStore K (Aux × Bool)) :
    Executes (body src dst) s (bodyStore src dst s) 2

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTake.body_working
statement:
theorem body_working (base : K → List Bool) (counter src dst : K) (hsd : src ≠ dst)
    (xs ys zs : List Bool) (a : Aux) (valid : Bool) (scratch : Option Bool) :
    bodyStore src dst (working3 base counter src dst xs ys zs (a, valid) scratch) =
      working3 base counter src dst xs ys.tail (ys.head?.getD false :: zs)
        (a, valid && ys.head?.isSome) ys.head?

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTake.prefix_eq_take
statement:
theorem prefix_eq_take (n : Nat) (xs : List Bool) (h : n ≤ xs.length) :
    paddedPrefix n xs = xs.take n

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackTake.prefix_length
statement: @[simp] theorem prefix_length (n : Nat) (xs : List Bool) : (paddedPrefix n xs).length = n

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackReadRelations.eval_costPolynomial
statement:
theorem eval_costPolynomial (tables : List (Nat × K)) (n : Nat) :
    (costPolynomial tables).eval n = cost tables n

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackReadRelations.input_length_le
statement:
theorem input_length_le (w : Workspace K) (n : Nat) (tables : List (Nat × K))
    (hf : ∀ r ∈ tables, Fresh w r.2) (s : BitStore K (Aux × Bool)) :
    ((result w n tables s).stk w.input).length ≤ (s.stk w.input).length

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackReadRelations.result_preserves
statement:
theorem result_preserves (w : Workspace K) (n : Nat) (tables : List (Nat × K))
    (key : K) (hi : key ≠ w.input) (ht : ∀ r ∈ tables, key ≠ r.2)
    (s : BitStore K (Aux × Bool)) : (result w n tables s).stk key = s.stk key

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackReadRelations.tables_ready
statement:
theorem tables_ready (w : Workspace K) (n : Nat) (tables : List (Nat × K))
    (hf : ∀ r ∈ tables, Fresh w r.2) (s : BitStore K (Aux × Bool)) (hs : Ready w n s) :
    Ready w n (result w n tables s)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackRename.executes_in_sum
Lax979537Proofs.StackRename.op_frame
statement:
theorem op_frame (f : K → L) (o : Op (fun _ : K => Γ) σ)
    (s : Store (fun _ : L => Γ) σ) (key : L) (hk : key ∉ Set.range f) :
    ((renameOp f o).apply s).stk key = s.stk key

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackRename.op_project
statement:
theorem op_project (f : K → L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (o : Op (fun _ : K => Γ) σ) (s : Store (fun _ : L => Γ) σ) :
    project f ((renameOp f o).apply s) = o.apply (project f s)

name: Lax979537Proofs.StackRename.rename_executes
statement:
theorem rename_executes (f : K → L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {p : Program (fun _ : K => Γ) σ} {s t : Store (fun _ : K => Γ) σ} {cost : Nat}
    (h : Executes p s t cost) (s' : Store (fun _ : L => Γ) σ) (hs : project f s' = s) :
    ∃ t', Executes (rename f p) s' t' cost ∧ project f t' = t ∧
      ∀ key, key ∉ Set.range f → t'.stk key = s'.stk key

name: Lax979537Proofs.TupleCoordinates.coordinate_ofFn
statement:
theorem coordinate_ofFn (base : α → BitStore K Aux) {k : Nat}
    (counter coord : Fin k → K)
    (hsep : (ports (List.ofFn (fun i => (counter i, coord i)))).Nodup)
    (values : Fin k → Nat) (a : α) (remaining : List Nat) (scratch : Option Bool) (i : Fin k) :
    (packTuple base (List.ofFn (fun i => (counter i, coord i))) a (List.ofFn values) remaining scratch).stk
      (coord i) = List.replicate (values i) true
